title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.13.3 - macOS Automatic Updates
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.13.3 - macOS Automatic Updates

- Enabled automatic signed launcher updates for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, including update checks on startup.
- Added a dedicated macOS update feed so Windows and Mac versions no longer interfere.
- The update center now correctly detects newer macOS versions and installs verified app updates with relaunch.
- Improved release packaging and validation for future macOS updates. Game and account data remain unchanged.
